# Third World Traveler

> > A resource examining global health risks, historical injustices, and critical perspectives on U.S. foreign policy and social inequality.

Third World Traveler provides documentation on tropical diseases and travel health, alongside critical analysis of colonialism, indigenous genocide, CIA operations, and systemic inequality through writings by whistleblowers like John Stockwell and educators like Jonathan Kozol.

## Key Topics

- Tropical diseases and infectious diseases
- Travel health and disease prevention
- Cholera, Dengue Fever, HIV/AIDS
- Hepatitis (A, B, C, E)
- Parasitic diseases (Amebiasis, Chagas's Disease, Filariasis)
- Indigenous genocide and colonialism
- CIA covert operations and secret wars
- Education inequality and public schools
- Native American history
- U.S. foreign policy critique

## Critical Analysis & Whistleblowers

- [John Stockwell page](https://thirdworldtraveler.com/Stockwell/John_Stockwell.html): CIA whistleblower John Stockwell's writings on secret wars
- [Jonathan Kozol](https://thirdworldtraveler.com/Third_World_US/JonathanKozol_page.html): Jonathan Kozol author page on education inequality & public schools

## Travel Health & Tropical Diseases

- [diseases](https://thirdworldtraveler.com/Disease/diseases.html): Index of tropical diseases: cholera, dengue, sleeping sickness, more

## Historical Documentation

- [American Holocaust - David Stannard](https://thirdworldtraveler.com/History/American_Holocaust.html): David Stannard's American Holocaust excerpts on indigenous genocide

## Optional

- [weather Greece](https://thirdworldtraveler.com/Weather/weather_Greece.html): Climate data for Athens, Thessaloniki, Crete & other Greek cities
